svg.title: Lens direction: reusable research knowledge and a supervised feedback loop
svg.desc: Lens first proves its value through traceable literature comparison. Its longer-term direction is to accumulate reusable facts and judgments across investigations, then support verifiable tools and researcher-reviewed experiments. New observations revise the knowledge and judgments available for the next decision. These directions are not shipped capabilities or a delivery schedule.
svg.text: Build toward a research loop that learns.
Each investigation should improve the knowledge available for the next decision.
Current v1 focus
Support a literature-based decision
Inspect sources, reconstruct experiments and compare papers.
Keep conditions, uncertainty and the path back to evidence visible.
Expansion direction
Carry knowledge across investigations
Reuse traceable facts and reviewed judgments across questions and collections.
Enable structured retrieval and research tools for researchers and agents.
Longer-term direction
Test hypotheses and revise judgments
Use verifiable tools and researcher-reviewed experiments to address gaps.
Assess new observations against earlier evidence, conditions and uncertainty.
Question
Knowledge + methods
Judgment + gaps
Next investigation
New observations update the available research knowledge.
Tools and experimental feedback are future directions, subject to researcher review; no delivery dates are implied.
